description: Read-only checks on a live project: url (requests the project's live addresses from The Deployer's side), containers (what runs and its state), app_logs (the app's own recent output, secrets removed), resources (load, memory, disk) or web_server (the HTTPS proxy's log). Fixed commands only; changes nothing. All but url need a server (not managed services). Needs Deploy access on the project.

project.description: The project's id, name or repository (owner/name).

workspace.description: A teammate's workspace id. Default: your own.

name: diagnose
title: Check a live server
